summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace objects in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (str(ref).startswith(str(self))), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ (inherited by _RDFNamespace) returns True only when str(ref) equals a stored term URI. Added NamespaceMembershipTest cases to test/test_namespace.py covering SH and Namespace prefix membership, RDFS label/example, and RDF type/_1. No commits made. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions, so they are unverified.
